pipeline.interviewDescription: A brief chat to capture your nuances. We ask about your preferences, formatting, and tone.
pipeline.extractionDescription: Your style is compiled into a portable JSON fingerprint. Structure, not magic.
pipeline.filterDescription: Run any text through the engine. It's rewritten to match your voice instantly.

architecture.architectureDescription: Built for precision, privacy, and performance. Our engine deconstructs your linguistic style and reconstructs it on demand.

privacy.localPrivacyDescription: Your identity.json lives on your device. It is never sent back to the LLM provider for training. You own the layer.

developerApi.developerApiDescription: Programmatic access to the Resonate Engine. Inject personality into your automated pipelines.
developerApi.zeroLatencyDescription: The Resonate Engine is optimized for ultra-low latency. It analyzes and re-ranks tokens in real-time without slowing down your generation stream.

identityStructure.identityStructuredDescription: Your persona isn't magic—it's data. We give you a portable, version-controlled JSON file that defines exactly how you sound, independent of the model you use.

audience.foundersDescription: Scale your thought leadership on LinkedIn and X without sounding like a generic bot. Maintain your unique authority.
audience.creatorsDescription: Automate your newsletter and blog drafts while keeping 100% of your stylistic flair and wit.
audience.supportTeamsDescription: Unify your brand voice across thousands of support tickets. Make every automated reply feel personal.
